theme: Light Theme (MealHQ: Ink / Mist / Lagoon ops + Mango accents)

headings.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Keep it expressive. Max size text-6xl.

body.rules: Clean, highly readable for dense data like delivery addresses and Interac references.

labels.rules: Uppercase, tiny text-xs, tracking-[0.15em] for table headers and overlines.

primary.description: Lagoon - MealHQ ops HQ color, matches logo HQ and mark.

secondary.description: Fresh green - delivered status, financial success, and trust.

accent.description: Mango - meal energy accents (highlights, warnings soft).

neutral.rules: Cool mist undertones aligned to MealHQ Mist canvas. No purple kitsch.

surfaces.bottom_nav: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-t border-black/5 shadow-[0_-8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]
surfaces.cards: Flat solid background #FFFFFF, border border-[#E6E4DD], rounded-2xl. Hover: -translate-y-1, shadow-lg transition-transform
surfaces.hero_overlay: bg-black/30 or gradient-to-r from-black/60 to-transparent for maximum image visibility

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid tinted border-border/60. Never pure gray.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Semantic variants: btn-primary (main CTA / save), btn-secondary (success: deliver, verify, approve), btn-danger (destructive confirm: delete, reject, cancel delivery), btn-outline (dismiss / Cancel that closes a sheet), btn-outline-danger (logout / soft leave). Icon: icon-btn-success | icon-btn-danger | icon-btn-neutral. Never use red for dismiss Cancel.
components.bottom_nav: Fixed bottom-0 w-full z-50 flex justify-around items-center h-16 pb-safe. Use Phosphor Icons.
components.data_cards: For today's deliveries: dense, tap-friendly full-width blocks with swipe or large button targets for 'Mark Delivered'.
components.status_badges: Soft background with dark text (e.g., bg-green-100 text-green-800) with rounded-full.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_system: Use generous padding: p-4 to p-6 for mobile cards, p-8 to p-12 for desktop sections.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid (Bento): grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized.
grids_and_layouts.marketing_grid: Tetris Grid: Asymmetrical, grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Break standard symmetry.
grids_and_layouts.mobile_first: Ensure tap targets are at least 48x48px. Limit image heights to max-h-[60vh] on mobile.

motion.transitions: Specific transitions only. e.g., transition-transform duration-200 ease-out. NO 'transition-all'.
motion.micro_interactions: Active state scale down (active:scale-95) for primary buttons like 'Mark Delivered'.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-in-up for dashboard lists (Framer Motion).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets 4.5:1 against backgrounds. Use text-shadow if placing text over images.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='mark-delivered-btn').

hero_tiffin.description: Partitioned Indian lunchbox - ideal for main hero or consumer portal dashboard background.

healthy_meals.description: Vegetable salad / meal prep - use for feature grids or consumer upcoming meals.

delivery_driver.description: Smiling delivery driver - use for provider marketing page or onboarding flow.

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for high-end, clean duotone/regular weights.

libraries.ui: shadcn/ui (customized severely to break the generic vercel look), sonner for toasts, lucide-react or phosphor-icons.
libraries.charts: recharts or shadcn charts for Daily Deliveries and Area Summary.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup a mobile-first UI with a persistent bottom navigation for Provider Admin (Dashboard | Customers | Deliveries | Payments | More).
2. Provider Dashboard must feature bento-box style widgets for Today's Deliveries, Pending, Outstanding, and Collections.
3. Implement one-tap delivery marking (Delivered/Missed/Cancelled) using large tap targets and trigger a 'sonner' toast upon action.
4. Consumer portal must be dead simple: upcoming delivery card, balance, and Interac reference submission form.
5. Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds on fixed headers or bottom navs. Use backdrop-blur-xl with solid tints.
6. Replace generic Inter font with Cabinet Grotesk (Headings) and Satoshi (Body) via next/font or standard web fonts.
7. Include `data-testid` on all buttons, form fields, and navigation items.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism effects (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g. transition: all). Target specific properties (e.g. transition-transform).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). Keep natural left-aligned reading flow.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or rounded-xl) with hover animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover, focus, active).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Use the exact image URLs provided. Do not use placeholder text or dummy image services.
